title: Video of Bill Lear at Bahnsen's labs

tellings.quote: There's even a video of Lear visiting Agnew Bahnsen's labs in North Carolina and witnessing Townsend Brown's gravitator experiments.

plain: Michels says there is film from the 1950s of the aviation businessman Bill Lear visiting the North Carolina laboratory of the businessman Agnew Bahnson, where he watched the inventor Townsend Brown's 'gravitator' experiments, devices Brown hoped would move by electric force in a way like anti-gravity. Michels mentions the video himself, without saying where it can be found, in his 2024 documentary on Brown. He brings it up to show that serious industry figures took Brown's work seriously.
